notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Dispatcher Mode, Tunnel Visuals Overhaul & More

From there, you are able to set routes for incoming and outgoing trains and make sure trains get to their destinations on time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330520/bb3834e2d05f072dae6371c07d29dd785ade15ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Tunnel Visuals Overhaul[/h2][p]The tunnels are no longer pitch-black and now have a more detailed texture, making the environment a lot less boring.[/p][p][/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][h3]New[/h3][p]- Added the following stations: Hillcrest, Skyline Plaza (between Pine Street/Hillcrest & Purple Bridge)[/p][p]- Added new line: Yellow Line - Runs between Hillcrest and Founder's Square, sharing most of the track with the purple line quad track[/p][p]- Added Dispatcher Mode: Play as a dispatcher in Weaver's Guild, Hillcrest Layup, Skyline Plaza, Founder's Square and Cheddar Street[/p][p]- Added statuses to the player list, which can now also be viewed with TAB instead of only through the lobby menu. These statuses also display in the Steam Friends List[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][p]- Every scheduled train now has their own unique train number, which shows in the timetable and the player status[/p][p]- Updated Founder's Square with 2 additional platforms for the yellow line[/p][p]- Added the ability to customize camera sensitivity while zoomed[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][p]- Overhauled Tunnel Visuals[/p][p]- Massive performance improvements[/p][p]- Improved automatic timetable assignment[/p][p]- Map now also shows cardinal directions in the top right corner[/p][p]- Improved passenger behaviour[/p][p]- Fixed the wrong cab hint not showing up when it should be in some circumstances[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that resulted in trains standing still for a couple of seconds and then teleporting when they were at full speed for everyone but the driver[/p][p]- Fixed some train sounds sometimes playing unintentionally[/p][p]- Quack[/p][p]- Minor bug fixes & improvements[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - New Stations, Quad Track & More
notes.content:
Our first map extension is now live! We heard all your feedback and have expanded the map with a new area, featuring quad track where express trains overtake local trains as they bypass three of the four new stations between Pine Street and Founder's Square.

This update also contains a bunch of bug fixes and performance improvements, aswell as password-protected lobbies and other multiplayer quality of life improvements.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the following stations: Purple Bridge, Bank, Royal Gardens, Rosengard Street
[*]Added express trains. On the Purple Line, express trains overtake local trains by skipping Purple Bridge, Royal Gardens and Rosengard Street
[*]Added password-protected lobbies: Players can now set passwords for their lobby on all lobby types. Players can choose to hide password-protected lobbies in the lobby browser.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Timetable now also shows the route's name and destination
[*]Friends Only lobbies now also show up in lobby browser for eligible players

[*]Friends now have a green name in chat (unless they are also the host)
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where trains could still get a route assigned after they had already despawned
[*]Fixed an issue where some Score Penalties could trigger multiple times in quick succession, when only one mistake was made by the driver
[*]Fixed an issue that resulted in way too many NPCs spawning in certain circumstances
[*]Fixed an issue where the Request Route keybind would click the Request Route button on all previously operated train cabs, requesting routes for all of them
[*]Performance improvements, especially for loading in areas
[*]Increased overall brightness slightly
[*]Adjusted tunnel lamps
[*]Keybinds can now be reset to default
[*]Quack
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

notes.title: The Future of Metrogether
notes.content:
[h2]First Map Extension Arriving![/h2]
We're excited to announce the launch of our first map extension on May 29th. Four brand-new and unique stations have been added into 4km of new quad track between Pine Street and Founder's Square: Purple Bridge, Bank, Royal Gardens and Rosengard Street.

Players can now experience a more diverse experience with the addition of express trains, which will bypass three of the four new stations. This bypass allows express services to overtake local trains, saving approximately 4 minutes off the full route and creating new possibilities for players to pass each other.

Beyond the expanded rail network, this update also delivers a host of performance improvements and bug fixes, ensuring a smoother experience. We've also enhanced multiplayer functionality, introducing password-protected lobbies for more private and controlled gameplay sessions.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We're committed to continue updating Metrogether with exciting new content. Our immediate focus for the coming months includes:
[list]
[*][b]Player Dispatchers:[/b] Players will be able to replace the automatic Dispatchers that route incoming and outgoing trains at some of the stations.
[*][b]Next Map Extension:[/b] Our next map extension will utilize the downtime in the quad track section as every track is only used once every six minutes at the moment.
[/list]
Both of these are planned for Late June/Early July.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4
notes.content:
We've been pretty silent the last couple of weeks, but that's because we've been busy working on the next big update that will add a section of quad-track for express and local trains with a couple of new and unique stations that are placed between Pine Street and Founder's Square.

We were able to find the time to work on this small performance and bugfix patch for the time being. This should get rid of the little stutters (or sometimes even crashes) that happen while moving through he world, which became very noticeable since we added lamps to the tunnels.
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved dynamic world loading, game should no longer stutter or sometimes crash when approaching areas that need to be loaded in
[*]Fixed AI drivers taking over vacant trains which were partly or entirely outside of platform bounds, resulting in them driving down the tracks without a route set and sometimes driving into oncoming traffic
[*]Fixed an issue where some Score Penalties could trigger multiple times in quick succession, when only one mistake was made by the driver
[*]Fixed an issue where requested routes could be unset due to them timing out even while the train that requested it was currently moving through the track section the route is for (this could only happen when routes time out 5 minutes after being set which is still the intended and current behaviour)
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

This patch is compatible with patches 1.1.0-1.1.3 and players of any of these versions can play together.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - AI Driver Personalities & Tunnel Improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone, welcome to the first regular update. We have heard your feedback, and understand that many of you think the map is too small. We agree, but we obviously couldn't add new stations in less than a week. Instead, we have focused our initial efforts on other areas such as replayability and other requested features.
[h2]AI Driver Personalities[/h2]
AI Drivers now have different personalities that have an impact on their driving style and how punctual they are and those personalities are visually reflected in the outfit they wear. This should increase the variety of situations you can encounter, especially in single player.

Currently, these personalities do not differ too much from the original driver, but we can easily tweak them if they do not have enough of an effect.
[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added AI Driver personalities
[*]Added a train horn
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added lamps to most tunnel sections
[*]Fixed characters skin variant loading broken while spawning in. This resulted in player characters not loading the correct variant when joining and npcs often having the same variants
[*]Fixed the `/player` aka `/who` command always resulting in a `Not looking at a player` error even if looking at another player
[*]Fixed option to spawn at station appearing on the map while operating a train even though you cannot teleport in that situation
[*]Potential fix for AI drivers sometimes getting stuck in front of a proceed signal
[*]Fixed third person camera jittering while on a moving train
[*]Increased overall brightness slightly
[*]Minor bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

This update is not compatible with prior versions and all players must update to 1.1.0 to play together in this version.

notes.title: Metrogether - Launch Details
notes.content:
Dear aspiring train drivers and dedicated ticket inspectors. With our release just a couple of days away, we'd like to provide further details regarding the launch of Metrogether.

[h2]Editions[/h2]
Metrogether will be available for $17.99 USD. For regional pricing, please refer to the game's store page upon release. We are also pleased to offer a 10% launch discount for the first eleven days.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239770/Metrogether_Train_Simulator/

For those who wish to offer additional support, we will also have a Supporter Pack available for $4.99 USD. As a thank you, this pack includes the ability to customize the color of your train.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644650/Metrogether__Supporter_Pack/

For players interested in buying the Supporter Pack immediately, the Supporter Edition offers a 5% discount on the combined price of the base game and the Supporter Pack.

[h2]Changes from the demo[/h2]
The release version of Metrogether includes several enhancements and additions based on your valuable feedback from the demo:
[list]
[*][b]Bigger Map:[/b] Six new stations await you in the expanded map, which results in a total of 9 stations on this first line.
[*][b]New Train Menu:[/b] You can now re-enable the AI driver and drive without a timetable from the new train menu.
[*][b]Improved Multiplayer Functionality:[/b] Hosts now have the ability to ban players, allowing for way better moderation in public multiplayer lobbies.
[/list]
[h2]Post-Launch Content[/h2]
While we don't have a detailed roadmap to share at this time, we are committed to listening to player feedback. Future content updates will be considered based on the level of community interest and feedback.

We eagerly anticipate welcoming you aboard Metrogether on April 24!

You can now re-enable the AI driver and drive without a timetable from the new train menu.
Hosts now have the ability to ban players, allowing for way better moderation in public multiplayer lobbies.

notes.title: New Rolling Stock!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to showcase our new rolling stock, which you can check out right now in the demo!

https://youtu.be/X_fU-XC7_Og

Alongside this new addition, the latest patch also includes lots of changes and fixes. We downgraded from DirectX 12 to DirectX 11, which resolved the memory leak which froze the UI sometimes and, most importantly, made the game way more stable.

Changes:
- Switched to DirectX 11. If you were not having any issues when running with DirectX 12, you can re-enable it with the launch option [code]-force-d3d12[/code]
- Added new rolling stock with a more detailed train model.
- Removed old rolling stock.

Fixes:
- Fixed UI freeze due to memory leak (because the memory leak does not occur on DirectX 11).
- Fixed an issue where the host could be disconnected from their own game when another client disconnected before they were properly connected, resulting in issues such as areas being unloaded and their character despawning.
- Fixed seats on trains being enterable from outside the train and vice-versa.
- Fixed timetable status changing when closing doors at last stop or opening doors at first stop.
- Minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Devlog: Speed Limits
notes.content:
Welcome to the second devblog,

Last time we talked about signals but for safe operations, you must also keep your speed in control, so that's what this dev blog will be about.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330520/bb92605a6553d6c44545b2f50da025546f059ee5.png[/img]

[h2]Speed Limit Signs[/h2]

Speed Limits are usually conveyed through speed limit signs, but they work a little differently to what you're used to when driving a car, as the speed limit is always ten times the specified amount. So, a sign with the number 2 means a speed limit of 20 kmh.

Speed Limit signs are square signs with black numbers on a white background.

[h2]Diverging Switch Speed Limit[/h2]

When there's a switch, the speed limit may depend on whether it is set to the straight or the diverging path. Switches that are set to the diverging path always have a speed limit of 40.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330520/740975e7511c683358f8964c31b976a058e4bed4.png[/img]

When the speed limit at a section of switches is above 40, signals before the switches will have an additional V-shaped lamp that indicates whether there is a switch that is set to a diverging path. When lit, you must obey a speed limit of 40 instead of the current speed limit.
